name: XOR by Nahiko
description: A single on-chain NFT running a neural-network XOR gate, visualized as a Yin-Yang.
about:
## The first fully on-chain neural network

XOR by Nahiko is a single ERC-721 (token ID 0) that holds a neural network entirely on-chain — a small XOR gate visualized as a Yin-Yang. The image has two spheres, or "hearts." The person who owns the NFT controls the left heart; the artist (Nahiko) controls the right heart.

## How it works

Each sphere is either on or off. `changeLeftSphere` (owner-only) and `changeRightSphere` (artist-only) flip their respective sphere. The network — three sigmoid neurons with fixed weights and biases — takes the two sphere states as inputs and computes an XOR: `isYingYang` returns true only when exactly one of the two spheres is on. Based on that state, `tokenURI` selects one of four PNGs hosted on IPFS; the state and URI selection are on-chain, but the image bytes are not stored in the contract.

The neural-network architecture references a source article, pinned on IPFS and returned by `sourceArticle`.
risks: The artist (Nahiko) permanently controls the right sphere and can reassign that control to any address via setNahikoAddress
Only a single token (ID 0) exists and there is no minting function; the collection cannot grow
The token images are externally hosted PNGs addressed by IPFS URIs, so display depends on the files remaining available through IPFS
The contract is not upgradeable, so its behavior is fixed permanently

changeLeftSphere.title: Toggle Left Sphere
changeLeftSphere.description: Flip the left sphere of the Yin-Yang on or off.
changeLeftSphere.warning: Only the current NFT owner can call this.

changeRightSphere.title: Toggle Right Sphere
changeRightSphere.description: Flip the right sphere of the Yin-Yang on or off.
changeRightSphere.warning: Only the artist (Nahiko) address can call this.

getCurrentState.title: Current State
getCurrentState.description: Returns whether the left and right spheres are currently on or off.

isYingYang.title: Is Yin-Yang?
isYingYang.description: Runs the on-chain neural network and returns true when the two spheres form a Yin-Yang (XOR).

getNahikoAddress.title: Artist Address
getNahikoAddress.description: Returns the artist (Nahiko) address that controls the right sphere.

setNahikoAddress.title: Set Artist Address
setNahikoAddress.description: Reassign the artist address that controls the right sphere.
setNahikoAddress.warning: Only the current artist can call this; setting the zero address permanently freezes both artist-only actions.

sourceArticle.title: Source Article
sourceArticle.description: Returns the IPFS URI of the article behind the neural network's design.

contractURI.title: Contract URI
contractURI.description: Returns on-chain collection metadata (ERC-7572), including name, image, and royalty info.
